tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists the services EuroVPS offers, with the product code to use in request_quote and a link to each page.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Sends a quote request to the EuroVPS sales engineers on behalf of the person you act for. Only use it when that person asked you to, with their real contact details and their permission to share them. An engineer replies to the email address given. The request is marked as sent by an AI agent.

product.description: Product code from list_services; use "unsure" if unclear.

name.description: Full name of the person requesting the quote.

email.description: Their work email; the reply goes here.

message.description: The workload and requirements: what runs, size, location, timing, current provider.

agent.description: Optional name of the AI agent or assistant sending this.

consent.description: Must be true: the person asked you to send this and agreed to share their details with EuroVPS.
